sourceReview: The helper is internal test support behind Darwin, CGO and the explicit fixture tag. It exposes no PID adoption, mutable command, arbitrary descendant-image matcher or production control API.

Creator-bound launch retains the original command and sole Wait. Minimal native cleanup identity is separate from full image, argv and event proof. A completed fast command grants no descendant authority when full admission failed.

Host discovery enforces the closed literal host grammar. Role discovery derives the exact four image paths and digests from verified assembly policy and retains runtime-prepared descriptors through a shared owner.

UID enumeration reads minimal identity before argv or paths, filters by immutable creation-parent identity, and repeats roster and identity observations after watches. Exec, uncertainty, extra or ambiguous children fail admission.
Private candidate admission exists only behind the separate diagnostic tag, exact tuple and shared self/UID/loader guards. Normal NewCreator still refuses SDK 27.
Argument parsing keeps its 256 KiB and 4096-byte string bounds, with a 64-argument cap that accommodates the 38 arguments needed for sixteen workspace roots.

Only EINTR retries. Diagnostic reads retain the original absolute deadline; zero-time proof observations permit at most three attempts. Watch and close failures retain concrete accounting without unsafe numeric-descriptor retry.
